title: ayenia byttnerioides
intro: Ayenia byttnerioides, commonly known as "Tree Ayenia" or "Sangre de Grado", is a plant species native to Central America. It is a medicinal plant used for its various health benefits, which include its ability to treat respiratory problems, fever, and inflammation due to its expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties. The therapeutic actions of Ayenia byttnerioides are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which are known for their antioxidant, antimicrobial, and antiviral activities. These bioactive compounds contribute to the plant's therapeutic potential in treating various health conditions and diseases.
